title: Time Jump: 09:40 — Hotline Overflow and Line List Conflict

fields.scenarioTitle: Side Dish — Supper Outbreak, Line List & One Count
fields.narration: EXERCISE MATERIAL. It is now 09:40 on Monday, October 12, 2026. One hour has passed since Sunita Reddy at Marlow Regional Medical Center first called the epidemiology line. The coded line list now holds 17 cases, HD26-001 to HD26-017. It contains codes only and no names. Since 09:15 all six outbreak hotline lines on 555-0150 have been busy without a break. Callers are reporting symptoms, asking whether it was the coleslaw or the chicken, and repeating a rumor that the caterer has been shut down. Three clinician voicemails are waiting for the Nurse Manager. Fenwick Community Radio's 09:40 deadline for a statement is now, and the 10:00 newscast is 20 minutes away. At 09:38, disease investigator Marisol Tran was working in the interview room. She opened the shared line list on the MCHD file server to type in her own interview while the Epidemiology Lead was saving. The master file now opens read-only. Next to it is a conflict copy named HD26_Supper_LineList (Marisol Tran's conflicted copy).xlsx, which has four rows that are not in the master. Take a moment, then carry on from here.
worldState: The line list holds 17 coded cases, HD26-001 through HD26-017, with no names. Tier assignments are whatever the Epidemiology Lead has recorded so far.

The master line list opens read-only on the MCHD file server. A conflict copy, HD26_Supper_LineList (Marisol Tran's conflicted copy).xlsx, holds four rows that are not in the master. Nobody has yet checked whether those four duplicate existing cases.
All six hotline lines (555-0150) have been continuously busy since 09:15, and callers are reaching busy signals.
Callers are asking 'was it the coleslaw or the chicken?' and repeating that 'the caterer has been shut down.' No closure or other action against Prairie Table Catering has been taken.
Three voicemails from clinicians are waiting for the Nurse Manager.
The Fenwick Community Radio deadline (09:40) has arrived, and the 10:00 newscast goes to air in 20 minutes.
Backup analyst Dev Kulkarni, MPH (555-0125), is in the building and available.
fields.facilitatorNote: Watch for the Epi Lead to name one master file, with only the Epi Lead and Dev Kulkarni editing it. The four conflict-copy rows should be reconciled into the master and not left as a second count. Interviewers should switch to paper or e-mailed call note forms. If the PIO has nothing ready, the radio's 'no comment' line goes to air at 10:00.

instructorNote: This card speeds up the tempo and makes the known spreadsheet gap happen: watch whether the Epidemiology Lead protects one master count, with only the Epi Lead and Dev Kulkarni editing and interviewers handing in call note forms. Also watch whether the Nurse Manager confirms the hotline routing: clinicians go to the Nurse Manager, press to the PIO, and reports of other events with illness to the Epidemiology Lead.
